description: Capability for the main window. No static fs:scope allowlist is declared here — `$DIALOG` is not a real Tauri path variable, so an entry like { "path": "$DIALOG/**" } would silently compile to a dead literal glob. Actual fs access is gated by runtime scope mutation: tauri-plugin-dialog calls scope.allow_file() after a dialog pick, tauri-plugin-fs does the same for drag-drop, and src-tauri/src/lib.rs's RunEvent::Opened handler does it for file-association launches.
